Live leaderboard thanks to [Arquimedes Canedo](https://github.com/arquicanedo/prc-challenge-2026)): <https://prc-challenge-2026.vercel.app/>

Here is a final leaderboard (and shared repo):

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| error: false
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

here::here("media", "ranking_final.csv") |>
  readr::read_csv() |>
  mutate(
    repo = if_else(
      !is.na(repo),
      str_glue(
        "https://github.com/prc-data-challenge-2026/{name}",
        name = team
      ),
      NA
    ),
    team = str_glue(
      "[{team}](https://ansperformance.eu/study/data-challenge/dc2026/teams/{team}.html)"
    ),
    NULL
  ) |>
  select(rank, team, rmse = rmse_2f_final, eligible, repo) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_url(columns = repo, label = "GitHub repo") |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = team) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = team) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = rmse,
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    rank ~ px(90),
    rmse ~ px(90),
    eligible ~ px(90)
  ) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_sorting = TRUE, # Enables column sorting controls (default is TRUE)
    use_pagination = FALSE
    # use_search = TRUE, # Optional: adds a global search bar
    # use_filters = TRUE # Optional: adds per-column filter fields
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  )
```


All paginated submissions can be retrieved via the REST API at the [full leaderboard JSON][leaderboard] (use the value of `nextCursor` in the `cursor=` parameter in the URL query).

Other endpoints are also available; have a look [here][api] and use `competitionId` = `bb3693e1-26bc-4a9e-8619-4fe78b4eab0c`.

## Submission Instructions

Teams will be ranked based on the **best \acr{RMSE}** achieved across their submissions.

The `submitting.parquet` file is provided as a template.
To make a submission, fill in the `TAXITIME_SEC_mvt` column with your predicted
taxi-out times for the corresponding `MVT_ID_mvt` values.

Each team must submit its predictions to its own bucket using the following file
naming convention: 

> `<team-name>_v<incremental integer>.parquet`  

For a submission to be valid, each row must match the corresponding
`MVT_ID_mvt` before the ranking script can use the prediction to calculate the
\acr{RMSE}. 

The ranking script will issue an error if: 

* an `MVT_ID_mvt` does not match;
* any rows are missing; or
* extra rows are included.

There is currently a **limit of 5 submissions per day** (and a 
**total max of 1GB per bucket**.)

::: {.callout-note title="Please note"}
You will **NOT** be able to submit via the webinterface, please use the 
**MinIO CLI** as described in the [Data](data.qmd) section. 
:::

## Final Submission
Please submit you unique final submission using the following filename:

> `<team-name>_final.parquet`
